protocol.assessments: Authoritative frozen-region H effects measured separately from recovery; intervals remain finite or explicitly approximate and subject to qualification/refusal.
not_covered: Every registered metric from one representative objective

calibration_bins.contrast: Frozen equal-width bin residual magnitude .30 versus zero

calibration_residual.contrast: Signed target residual +.30 versus zero at supplied p=.5

paired_degradation.contrast: Common-population candidate minus reference error .30 versus zero

paired_precision.contrast: Common issued base; reference precision .90, candidate .60 in the region and .90 outside; distinct positive denominators

ranking_ap.contrast: Reversed versus correctly ordered noisy scores at balanced label prevalence

ranking_auc.contrast: Reversed versus correctly ordered noisy score distributions

regression_bias.contrast: Signed mean bias .90 versus zero with bounded independent noise

uncertainty_efficiency.contrast: Issued interval widths 4 versus 2 metres, with unchanged perfect coverage

protocol.primary: Positive-native-effect S-selected union evaluated on independent H; unavailable counts stay in planned recall.
protocol.region: categorical a=1 AND continuous x>.5; expected prevalence .125
protocol.strategy_claims: Unified runs do not qualify every strategy. Separate --strategies ablations retain the same profile and separate evidence.
